name: Hollow Tree
description: An ancient hollow tree at the edge of the Fairy Ring glade, large enough inside for a compact hidden chamber. Shelves of bottles and herbs, low furnishings, and branching amber lights make the space look half woodland refuge and half concealed workshop.
atmosphere: Warm bark, crushed herbs, and a faint mechanical hum. The chamber feels sheltered, but ladders and seams among the roots suggest that it has more exits than a tree ought to possess.
notes: Coinín knows and uses this safehouse. Its lower root chamber has two distinct routes: an ordinary Fey-built service tunnel reaches the Hidden hatch near the far side of the Fairy Ring glade, while a concealed permanent Fairy Door connects to the Hidden Fairy Door in the woods west of Trí Mhuilinn. The service tunnel is the established fail-forward escape during The Encounter; the Fairy Door is a portal and must not be narrated as a root tunnel or as literal magic.
